name: HUMAN RUNBOOK — one 5-minute shell session closes D2 and publishes the docs increment (order matters, do not improvise)
description:
Consolidates what used to be three separate high-priority human cards (`ec0a31db` closed, `537e8ee7`, `e27a5d03`) into one ordered sequence. Every agent profile on this project has no `sh`/exec tool, so none of this can be done from a shift — that is why this card exists as one batched human action instead of three.

State verified on 2026-11-24 17:5xZ:
- `srcExclude` (`config.mts:13`) is **already committed in HEAD** — the two P0 review pages are excluded at repository level. No commit needed for that. (Card `ec0a31db` closed as already satisfied; the last three shifts had this wrong.)
- The **only** pending line in `.vitepress/config.mts` is the sidebar entry `link: '/features/company-spaces'`, and `features/company-spaces.md` (120 lines) is **untracked**.
- `docs/package-lock.json` has **0** `vitest` entries while `package.json` declares `"test": "vitest run"`.
- `qa/tests/site-integrity.test.mts` now holds **12 cases**, 5 of them a route-claim guard (canary + pre-fix-wording red fixture + corrected-wording positive control). It cannot run without a lockfile that installs vitest.
- The working tree has ~86 changed files, most of them `.codx/**` control-plane noise.

## Steps — in this order, do not skip

**0. Verify the deployment (browser only, 1 min).** Open on the public site:
`/features/workspaces-settings-scope-review` and `/features/workspaces-container-routing-review`.
Expected: **404**. If either renders, the site was built before the `srcExclude` commit → record the URL and the date on `60917b9a` (disclosure + cache/Archive.org purge).

**1. Confirm the root before anything else.**
`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` · `git status --short | wc -l` (expect ~86).

**2. Fix the lockfile (this is D2).**
`cd docs && npm install`
`git add package-lock.json && git commit -m "docs: regenerate package-lock so npm ci installs vitest"`
Commit **only** `package-lock.json` here.

**3. Prove the guard actually runs.**
`npx vitest run` → expect **≥12 passed, 0 failed**. Paste the output on `537e8ee7` and `49007737`.
**If it is red, stop.** Do not proceed to step 4 and do not commit content.

**4. Publish the increment — only if step 3 is green and D3 is decided.**
`git add .vitepress/config.mts features/company-spaces.md <the 4 approved content files from e27a5d03>`
`git commit -m "docs: publish company spaces page and the pending content increment"`
The two files must land **together**: `config.mts`'s only pending change is a nav link to `company-spaces.md`, so committing it alone ships a **404 nav entry** that `ignoreDeadLinks: true` will not catch.

## Hard rules
- **Never** `git add -A`, `git add .` or `git commit -am` — the tree carries ~86 files, mostly `.codx/**` runtime state. Naming paths is the whole point.
- **Never** commit `.codx/**`. That is M6 (`8909f356`, `82314f38`), a separate decision.
- Do not run `git rm -r --cached .codx` in this session; it is not needed for the increment.

## Acceptance
- Step 0 answer recorded (404 or a dated exception on `60917b9a`).
- `npx vitest run` green with ≥12 cases, output pasted.
- One commit containing `.vitepress/config.mts` + `features/company-spaces.md` + only approved content files; `git show --stat HEAD` attached.
- If any step fails: comment here with the exact output and stop — no partial commits.

Reversible: yes. Each step is a normal commit; `git revert <sha>` undoes it.

messages.content: Run the four steps in this card in order, from the git root, and paste the output of each step back here. Step 0 is browser-only and needs no shell. Steps 2-4 need a shell — no agent profile on this project has one.

⚠️ COMMIT SCOPE GREW — step 5 of this runbook must name 6 files, not 4.

Two content fixes landed in the tree during shift 15 (card `41ec27a7`, verified): `features/browser-use.md` (+297/-10) and `features/voice-conversation.md` (+3/-2). They must ship in the same commit, otherwise the published pages keep the defects this increment is meant to close.

Replace the commit step with an explicit list — never `-a`/`-am`:

```
git add .vitepress/config.mts features/company-spaces.md features/browser-use.md features/voice-conversation.md
git status --short          # expect ONLY those 4 paths staged; nothing under .codx/
git commit -m "docs: publish increment — company-spaces page + nav, browser-use route table, voice barge-in wording"
```

Untouched by us and therefore not to be staged: `docs/package-lock.json` (step 3 regenerates it — commit it separately and only if `npm install` produced a real diff), and anything under `.codx/**`.

Everything else in this card still holds: deploy check first, `npx vitest run` before the commit, stop on red.

⚠️ ONE MORE THING BEFORE STEP 5 — and it has an order.

I verified the `browser-use.md` route table by hand after the fix. The table is now single-source (one heading L478, one table L480–511) and recipe deletion is correct at item level. **But the table is incomplete**: two routes are named in the page's prose and have no row — `GET .../images/catalog` (prose L206) and `POST /api/browsers/{id}/control` (prose L540). So the commit as it stands would publish a page whose route table is provably incomplete.

That is being fixed by a separate card (docs-only edit to the same file, no shell needed, owner `biblio`, due before you run this). Two ways to run this:

- **Preferred:** wait for that edit to land in the tree, then run this runbook once. Same 4-file commit, nothing extra.
- **If you must run now:** the 4-file commit still ships — the table gap is a completeness defect, not a wrong claim, and it becomes a small follow-up commit. Do NOT let this block the D2 publish if the window is tight.

Unchanged and still critical: `git add` the 4 paths explicitly (never `-A`, never `-am`), nothing under `.codx/**`, stop on a red `npx vitest run`. If `vitest` is still absent after `npm install`, stop and comment — do not push untested, and do not "fix" the lockfile by deleting it.

## ⚠️ STOP — the commit list on this runbook is wrong. It would publish 2 dead nav links. Corrected list below (measured 2026-11-25T09:2xZ).

The runbook says *"4 content changes + `features/company-spaces.md` explicitly"*. The tree has **9 changed paths**, and the file it misses is the one the **new nav entries point at**.

`.vitepress/config.mts` (+2, uncommitted) adds **two** nav links, not one:

```diff
+ { text: 'Company tickets (unattended workbench)', link: '/features/company-tickets' },
+ { text: 'Company files and coworking spaces', link: '/features/company-spaces' },
```

`features/company-tickets.md` is **untracked** (105 lines, real content — company ticket workbench, `/api/companies/{id}/tickets`). `features/index.md` (+2) and `features/autonomous-tickets.md` (+1/−1) also link to `/features/company-tickets`. So a commit of the config + those two pages **without** `company-tickets.md` publishes a dead nav entry and two dead inline links — and `ignoreDeadLinks: true` (`54658755`) will make the build green anyway, so nobody would notice until a reader clicks.

### Use this file list — one commit, no `git commit -am`

```
.vitepress/config.mts                      M  +2   -0
features/index.md                          M  +2   -0
features/autonomous-tickets.md             M  +1   -1
features/browser-use.md                    M  +318 -10   ← +2 rows landed this shift
features/voice-conversation.md             M  +3   -2
qa/README.md                               M  +63  -23
qa/tests/site-integrity.test.mts           M  +251 -0
features/company-spaces.md                 ?? new
features/company-tickets.md                ?? new   ← MISSING FROM THE RUNBOOK
```

```
git add .vitepress/config.mts features/index.md features/autonomous-tickets.md \
        features/browser-use.md features/voice-conversation.md \
        qa/README.md qa/tests/site-integrity.test.mts \
        features/company-spaces.md features/company-tickets.md
git status --short          # expect exactly 9 staged, 0 untracked in features/
git commit -m "docs: browser-use route table, company tickets & spaces pages, nav"
```

### Why the two `qa/` files are in the same commit, not a second one
`qa/tests/site-integrity.test.mts` (+251) asserts on the **working tree**, not `HEAD` (`f247ada9`). Committing the two new pages together with the suite is what keeps T2 green **after** the commit; splitting them re-creates exactly the defect that card describes.

### Unchanged from the original runbook
- **Step 0 still first:** the 404 check for `/features/workspaces-*-review` (`60917b9a`) — record the answer before anything else.
- **Never** `git add .codx/**`. No `git rm -r --cached .codx` in this session.
- Acceptance is unchanged: 9 paths (`git show --stat HEAD`), no `.codx`, step 0 recorded.

If the missing page cannot be added, the **safe alternative** is to drop the two nav lines from `config.mts` in the same commit — but that is a worse increment and it re-opens `features/index.md`. Recommendation: commit all 9.

- `features/company-tickets.md` is **tracked** (atlas: `features/company-tickets.md:1` … `:73-90`, 6 sections incl. `## API`), and it is absent from the 15-path untracked list. **The dead nav entry the original list would have published does not exist.**
- `features/browser-use.md` is committed with the 32-row REST table intact, L484 `/api/computers/images/catalog` and L489 `/api/browsers/{id}/control` present.
- `project_changes(paths=[".codx"], scope="all")` → 11 paths still dirty **but nothing under `.codx` is staged** (`repository_status`), so the publish did **not** commit control-plane state.

**Remaining half of this runbook: the JS toolchain (D2).** Unchanged and still blocking every executable gate: `npm not found in PATH` (`qa_plan`: `npm` suite `available: false`) and `docs/package-lock.json` has no `vitest` entry. That is `537e8ee7` (needs a shell) + `229b87e0` (`pytest:qa` exits 1 with 0 collected). Re-arming to the same wake as `537e8ee7` so the two are read together; do not re-run the publishing steps.
